# r4.1

- Speeds up synchronization's initial remote inventory by listing up to four independent folders on the existing SFTP connection. Server-advertised handle limits are respected; a failed limits query selects serial listing.
- Preserves complete-inventory validation before transfer or deletion, exclusions, shared listing limits, cancellation, and read/close error handling. Comparison, upload and deletion policies are unchanged.

Promotes the remote-inventory implementation tested in r4.1-pre.1 without additional runtime changes. The improvement primarily targets checking folder-heavy trees; results depend on latency, layout and server limits.

Stable release, replacing r4.0 as Latest. Uses the existing application registration, settings and normal updater channel.
